name: Dr. Olukayode O. Jegede
title: Principal Investigator
bio: Dr. Jegede is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Environmental Toxicology at UC Davis. His research focuses on understanding the ecological impacts of environmental pollutants through the study of soil bioindicators. He specializes in assessing the effects of pesticides, heavy metals, PFAS, and microplastics on soil invertebrates.
researchFocus: Environmental toxicology, soil ecotoxicology, bioindicators, pollutant effects on invertebrates

name: Isiaka Salau
bio: I am an Animal Biology Master's student at UC Davis, specializing in the intersection of animal science and computational technology. With a strong background in software engineering and data science, I leverage automation and bioinformatics to solve complex biological challenges.
researchFocus: Effect of different toxic compounds on the growth and behaviour of mites

name: Meena Pandey
bio: Meena grew up in the beautiful city of Kathmandu, Nepal, and earned her B.S. in Agriculture from Tribhuvan University. Meena is an M.S. candidate in the Jegede Lab, where she is working on two projects: soil ecotoxicology and the valorization of pomegranate peels to improve pollinator health. She seeks to assess the habitat quality of Californian vineyard soils and how it influences the resilience of soil biodiversity to pesticides and metals. This work helps us understand how Californian vineyard soils protect soil biodiversity from the effects of contamination through toxicokinetic or toxicodynamic processes. Her second research focus examines whether pomegranate peel extracts can be optimally used as a sustainable dietary supplement to improve honeybee immunity, antioxidant capacity, pesticide resilience, and overall colony health while valorizing agricultural waste. When she is not in front of her computer, Meena enjoys cooking wholesome Nepali cuisine, spending time in the kitchen, and catching up on sleep, which she proudly considers one of her most underrated productivity tools.
researchFocus: Soil ecotoxicology, vineyard soil habitat quality, and pollinator health
